{#-
	Manav Banded Quotation: print format of ERPNext's Quotation - modern layout in black and white: dark title band, grey cards, items table with grey row banding, dark grand-total bar.

	Working: this only names the colours (theme) and the layout file (body_template); the
	values are gathered by manav/templates/print_formats/manav_quotation_data.html,
	which then draws the layout. Change the colours here, the layout in the body file.

	Created: 2026-10-19, when the user asked for 3-4 quotation formats with colour and row banding.

	CHANGE NOTE
	Date: 2026-10-19
	Change: Only Manav Colour Quotation is in colour; Classic and Banded are black and white
	(grey banding). Banded Blue was renamed Manav Colour Quotation, Banded Green became the
	black-and-white Manav Banded Quotation, Banded Red was removed.
	Reason: The user asked for colour on one quotation format only.
-#}
{%- set theme = {"primary": "#2b2b2b", "dark": "#111111", "tint": "#f2f2f2", "band": "#f8f8f8", "border": "#d4d4d4", "accent": "#9a9a9a"} -%}
{%- set body_template = "manav/templates/print_formats/manav_banded_quotation_body.html" -%}
{% include "manav/templates/print_formats/manav_quotation_data.html" %}
name: Manav Banded Quotation
